steps.name: Mysterious building looking up at the sky
steps.objective: Visit “The Star in the Sky” and find out what happened. Then report to [Arcane] at the “Oscuras Temporary Garrison”.

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: Huh? What's going on?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let’s ask about the building behind.)

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: This? It's a strange building I'm investigating.

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: When you go inside, there are a series of stairs leading up to the ceiling. And at the end, there is a large stone door that cannot be opened.

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: We mobilized all of the members' strength, but in the end we were unable to open or break the door.

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: If it looked like the structure from the outside, the back of the door would have been empty. Pickman said so. … But my intuition is speaking. There's definitely something on the other side of the door.

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: Haha. You look like you can't believe it. doesn't care. I just do what I want.

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: How about you go in and go up? It may not be anything special, but the view from above is not bad.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (After finishing speaking, Arcane smiled lowly. ...Shall we go in and go upstairs?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The stone gate rattled with a low vibration.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I think I vaguely heard something coming from the other side of the door.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I think I can open the door. Shall we go in first?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Huh? But this familiar face wearing a small, winged golden helmet...?!)
(Crumbling…)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The sound of heavy breathing is definitely mixed with the growl of an animal.)
… human being… impression. How did you get in?
… … The smell of wolves... … … You and Jeril's scent are mixed together...

lines.speaker: 하와
lines.text: My name is Eve. The owner of this sky castle.

lines.speaker: 하와
lines.text: Human… What are you… ? What does it have to do with Jeril... ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What should I answer?)

lines.speaker: 하와
lines.text: Friends?

lines.speaker: 하와
lines.text: That foul-tempered white wolf... ?

lines.speaker: 하와
lines.text: A friend of that nasty and mean white wolf?!

lines.speaker: 하와
lines.text: … Jeril's friend is my enemy.

lines.speaker: 하와
lines.text: It makes you regret even meeting the white wolf!!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Eve doesn't seem to get along very well with Jeril.)

choices.text: 2. I am the human who defeated Jeril!

lines.speaker: 하와
lines.text: You beat Jeril?!

lines.speaker: 하와
lines.text: Don't lie!!! Although he is a white wolf with a dirty and mean temper, his skills are certain!

lines.speaker: 하와
lines.text: There is no way Jeril could be defeated by a mere human!!!

lines.speaker: 하와
lines.text: You're tarnishing Jeril's reputation with lies... I can't forgive. I won’t make you regret it!!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I can't tell if my relationship with Jeril is good or bad.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...If you're going to get so angry, why did you ask about Jeryl in the first place?)

lines.speaker: 하와
lines.text: … You are quite strong, human. What's your name?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Eve's voice was heard from behind the door. Eve was told her name.)

lines.speaker: 하와
lines.text: …… You resemble the humans who used to live here.

lines.speaker: 하와
lines.text: Strong and shining with conviction... They were people who felt a mysterious energy.

lines.speaker: 하와
lines.text: When humans see me, they squeal and make noise and pull out their swords, so I hate humans, but they weren't that bad.

lines.speaker: 하와
lines.text: We played together often. Dalian… ? That's what they called it.

lines.speaker: 하와
lines.text: I had forgotten since when they stopped coming, but today...

lines.speaker: 하와
lines.text: Today I feel similar to that time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Could it be the humans that Eve is talking about...)

lines.speaker: 하와
lines.text: Come back anytime, human. no. %s.

lines.speaker: 하와
lines.text: Let's play again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Eve’s presence disappeared.)
